text: I can't give you a verified current figure: I have no live data, and my knowledge ends in June 2026. The last range I'm confident of is 3.50-3.75%, set at the December 2025 FOMC meeting. I'm not sure whether it changed in 2026, and any meetings after my cutoff (including the September 2026 one) are unknown to me. The authoritative source is the target range on federalreserve.gov, or the FOMC statement from the most recent meeting.
